title: American Military University and American Public University Recognize Third Quarter 2026 President's List Honorees
summary: American Military University and American Public University Recognize Third Quarter 2026 President's List Honorees
body_markdown:
## AMU and APU Celebrate Students’ Highest Academic Achievement


**Charles Town, WV – October 2, 2026** –[American Military University (AMU)](https://www.amu.apus.edu/) and[American Public University (APU)](https://www.apu.apus.edu/) part of American Public University System are proud to recognize students who have earned the distinction of the President’s List for the third quarter of 2026. The President’s List is the academic units’ highest level of academic recognition.


View the[full list of students named to the President’s List here](https://militaryplus.apus.edu/docs/site/-/presidents-list-achievers/october-2026-presidents-list.pdf) .


“Being named to the President's List is a significant achievement and a testament to our students' focus and determination”, said AMU and APU President, Nuno Fernandes. "We are proud to recognize their academic success and celebrate the commitment they have shown."


“The students recognized on this quarter's President's List have demonstrated an exceptional commitment to learning and personal growth,” said AMU and APU Provost, Dr. Elizabeth Joy Johnson. “Their discipline shows they will be prepared to make meaningful contributions in their careers and in our communities.”


For more info on the President’s List,[click here](https://www.apu.apus.edu/student-handbook/your-apus-community/student-affairs/presidents-and-deans-lists/) .


**About American Military University and American Public University**


[American Military University (AMU) and American Public University (APU)](https://militaryplus.apus.edu/) part of American Public University System provide high-quality, affordable higher education that helps transform lives and advance careers. AMU and APU’s workforce-relevant education is preparing nearly 90,000 active students for service and leadership worldwide. AMU and APU have a rich history and vibrant community of over 173,000 alumni from more than 80 countries.


American Public University System is accredited by the Higher Learning Commission (HLC), an institutional accreditation agency recognized by the U.S. Department of Education. With approximately 109,000 students and over 250,0001 alumni worldwide, the System is a wholly owned subsidiary of American Public Education, Inc. (Nasdaq: APEI). For more information, visit[www.apus.edu](http://www.apus.edu/) .


1As of June 30, 2026.
